scope: Read-only audit of all 200 manifest episodes and 94000 recorded 20Hz samples; no implementation changes
method: Concatenate actions_7d, state_8d, joint_positions_rad, joint_targets_rad, joint_velocities_rad_s from every manifest trajectory.npz; compare positions/targets with named joints in original MuJoCo scene.xml model
speed_caveat: Maximum is over stored 20Hz samples, not every physics step; adapter checks stop threshold at each physics step. Target slew limits are not actual joint speed limits.

actual_position_limit_exceedance.explanation: MuJoCo joint constraints are soft. Motor commands remain bounded; measured positions are not guaranteed to stay strictly inside the range. Adapter has no measured-position-exceedance stop.

mapping.frame: MuJoCo world (identity world_to_policy frame in dataset)
mapping.arm: bounded least-squares IK over five arm joints
mapping.hand: binary open >0.5 selects fixed 8-motor open pose, otherwise closed pose
mapping.state: palm xyz + tool rotvec + synthetic aperture/-aperture proxy; not thirteen motor positions

normalization.dataset_actions: unnormalized dimensionless controller values; not direct meters/radians
normalization.training: q01/q99 from train split only; first six action axes normalized, binary hand axis unchanged
normalization.checkpoint_caveat: Original LIBERO checkpoint has shape 8x7 output and 8D proprio but Panda embodiment statistics/semantics do not establish SO-101 compatibility. Train and deploy with newly computed dataset statistics together; do not reuse original LIBERO quantiles.

compatibility_conclusion: Supported for collected reachable normal cup-transfer trajectories through current ActionAdapter, not arbitrary 6DOF pose goals or independent eight-motor hand control.
